item.description:
Labwrk 1.1.6 makes the initial running state clearer.
- Running pipeline Status badges show the filled blue clock icon while zero jobs have finished, instead of an empty progress ring. - Once the first job finishes, the badge switches to the actual job-completion wedge. Zero progress remains zero in the underlying data and accessibility description; no progress is invented. - Genuinely pending pipelines keep their neutral waiting indicator. Menu bar dots are unchanged.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.5 refines running indicators and successful-completion notifications.
- Running pipelines use a blue #1F75CB outline with a transparent interior in the menu bar. The outer diameter remains five points, matching every other dot state. - Successful-completion notifications say “Finished” and describe the pipeline as “finished”. The GitLab-style panel continues to label successful pipelines “Passed”.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.4 updates the running-job icon and default indicator window.
- Running stages/jobs use the supplied labwrk-progress-icon-2.svg geometry: shorter clock hands with 1.6-point white strokes, keeping the clock elbow at the circle center. - The default indicator window is now 1 hour. New settings and older settings without a saved window use 60 minutes; explicit saved selections are preserved. Change an existing selection under Preferences → Indicator time window.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.
